outcome: A negative intermediate value is used as zero in a calculation that determines an effect's result, while a creature's own power or toughness may stay below zero.
A number that cannot be determined is treated as 0 in the result or calculation.
A spell with {X} in its mana cost cast without paying its mana cost or an alternative cost with X has X = 0, so X-dependent effects do nothing.
note: The choice of X is forced to 0; the observable consequence is the resolution's effect.

outcome: X takes the value defined by the spell or ability text, and follows that value if it changes while the object is on the stack.
X in a spell or ability uses the X value of the other object it refers to.
X in the mana cost of a card outside the stack counts as 0.
Paying an object's mana cost containing X uses 0 unless the object is a spell on the stack, where it uses the cast value.
X in a gained ability has the value that ability defines, or 0 if it defines none.
X in an activated ability's cost is independent of other X values of the object.
An enters-the-battlefield ability or replacement effect referring to X uses the X of the spell that became the permanent, while the permanent's own X is 0.
A delayed triggered ability referring to an undefined X uses the X of the object that created it.
A {C} cost can be paid only with colorless mana.
A hybrid symbol can be paid with mana of either half: either color, or one mana of its color or two generic for a monocolored hybrid.
A Phyrexian symbol can be paid with one mana of its color or 2 life, so a spell is castable with no mana when its controller can pay the life.
note: Which way to pay is a decision; whether either way is available is a legality verdict.

outcome: A {S} cost can be paid only with mana produced by a snow source, and generic cost reductions do not reduce it.
An ability with {T} in its cost cannot be activated if the permanent is tapped or, for a creature, has not been under its controller's control since the turn began.
An ability with {Q} in its cost cannot be activated if the permanent is untapped or, for a creature, has not been under its controller's control since the turn began.
Paying a loyalty cost puts N loyalty counters on the planeswalker for [+N] or removes N for [-N].
A leveler with level counters in the stated range has the base power and toughness and abilities of that level symbol.
A leveler with at least N3 level counters has the base power and toughness and abilities of that level symbol.

note: Icon with no effect on game play.
Icon with no effect on game play.

outcome: Paying {E} removes one energy counter from the player.
A chapter ability triggers when lore counters are added and the count goes from below N to at least N.
Activating a level bar sets the Class's level to N, only at sorcery speed from level N-1, and the Class has the level's abilities at level N or greater.
Paying a ticket cost removes that many ticket counters from the player.
